method: Official references opened and relevant guidance read; same-day legal/syllabus evidence reused where stated.

sources.finding: Read chapter 2 section 8: remain and assist regardless of fault, information/police duties, moving an obstructing vehicle with stricter serious-injury evidence rules. Read chapter 3 sections 51 and 57: move breakdowns promptly, warn sufficiently early without a universal triangle distance. Reused same-day checks of speed/control and crossing/parking duties for the mixed journey; its earlier-module rules remain unchanged.

Motorway/2+1 advice confirms safest available stopping place, hazard lights, leave car and road, wait outside barrier where available, professional recovery and 112 for danger to life. At least 100 m is explicitly agency advice, not presented as a universal legal distance.

Non-urgent: remain in car or protected nearby and summon assistance. Urgent/fire: leave for nearest emergency exit and use assistance point/phone or 112; follow signs, announcements and personnel. The artwork keeps the exit approach open.
1177 first-aid landing page verified. Only brief referral retained as authorised; no clinical procedures, pulse checks or additional clinical illustrations added.

Agency page confirms immediate reporting/marking and separate 200 m precaution for boar, bear, lynx and wolf. Manuscript retains safe-and-possible qualification and explicitly does not generalise statutory reporting requirements to every species.

Current category B page confirms five knowledge areas and standard 70 questions, 65 scored, at least 52 points, 50 minutes. Approved manuscript date label of 1 October retained; these facts were rechecked on 7 October. Practice wording is not official test content.
Official practical-test page confirms safety check, special manoeuvring and driving in traffic; learner must explain defect response and apply knowledge.
English is an available category B language; language is selected at booking and interpreter support follows an application route.
Extended time, oral test and interpreter support require the applicable application; supported test booking follows approval. No promise of eligibility or immediate adjustment is made.

Self-assessment goals in chapters 2–5 section 3 support evaluation of ability, behaviour, journey choices and personal influences. Same-day official PDF checks reused from 6J and relevant paragraphs reopened.

sign_sources: Exact official image/caption register reused with hash and size checks; not every sign page fetched again.

G10_sources.title: Kontrollera kylarvätskenivån
G10_sources.version: MQ4 / 2022 / Swedish manual; live manufacturer edition, no revision date shown
G10_sources.locator: VIKTIGT: Ta bort kylarlocket; pressure-release explanation and following warning; VARNING: Kylarlock
G10_sources.excerpt: Het kylvätska och ånga kan strömma ut och orsaka allvarliga brännskador.
G10_sources.supports: Never remove radiator cap while engine/radiator is hot or running; pressure can remain even engine off; pressure release can expel hot liquid/steam causing severe burns.
G10_sources.fallback_reason: TS/TRV searches for kylarlock, hot coolant, cooling-system pressure and burns found no exact technical warning. Approved manufacturer fallback R-COOLANT gives complete mechanism.
G10_sources.scope_limits: Manufacturer technical warning for a conventional pressurised cooling system. Actual radiator/expansion-tank layout and stopping instructions vary: use own handbook/recovery advice. Do not generalise Kia opening steps, refill quantities/mixture, fan/battery procedure or fixed waiting time. The lesson gives no roadside cap-opening/repair instructions.

G10_sources.title: Om du får stopp på bilen – varna, lämna och larma
G10_sources.supports: Motorway/2+1-road protect people from traffic, safest available stopping place, leave car/road and call recovery; 112 for danger to life.
G10_sources.scope_limits: Preferred agency scene-safety support; not coolant technical evidence. Motorway/2+1-road advice not universal tunnel waiting instruction. No numerical triangle distance added by G10.

G10_sources.title: Säkerhet i vägtunnlar
G10_sources.locator: Om bilen går sönder eller om det händer en olycka; Om det brinner
G10_sources.excerpt: Om läget är akut: Lämna bilen
G10_sources.supports: Non-urgent tunnel: stay in car/protected nearby while getting help; urgent/fire: exit to nearest emergency exit and summon help.
G10_sources.scope_limits: Agency scene-safety cross-link only, not technical cooling-system instruction. Smoke/fire urgent; do not diagnose roadside source before responding to immediate danger.
